description: Read or set store configuration. get_settings/set_settings cover non-secret site settings (contact form destination email, phone, address, language, newsletter, logo). get_payments/set_payments cover the payment provider, currency and country — setting country auto-fills currency/language and returns recommended providers (paystack ZA/NG/KE/GH, payfast ZA, ozow ZA, stripe US/UK/EU/global, flutterwave Africa, razorpay IN, paypal global, mercadopago LATAM). API keys and payment secrets must be entered in the seller dashboard — they cannot be set here for security. Read before you write.

contact_address.description: set_settings: business address shown on the site

contact_email.description: set_settings: email that receives contact form submissions

contact_phone.description: set_settings: business phone shown on the site

country.description: set_payments: ISO country code, e.g. "ZA", "US" — auto-sets currency and language

logo_image_url.description: set_settings: public URL of the site logo image (PNG/SVG, transparent bg preferred). Applied to header and footer blocks that have no logo image of their own. Obtain via manage_media(action="upload_url"|"upload_file"|"generate", section="logo") first.

newsletter_list_id.description: set_settings: audience/list ID from the provider

testMode.description: set_payments: true = test/sandbox (no real charges); false = live

name: manage_store_settings
